content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on runtime cluster rtd-02; queue depth above configured target (avg 78%, tail 98%). Auto-pager -> Sam O'Neill.
Sam O'Neill: I'm on it. where's the dashboard link?
incident-bot: https://console.redwood.ai/obs/runtime/rtd-02/alerts/1759876543 (auto-attach)
Sam O'Neill: seeing a spike in request latency and backlog, especially on /v1/generate routes. Error pattern is downstream timeout and 'kv cache full' logs.
Maya R.: looking at ingress and rate metrics — sudden bump from a handful of high-throughput clients. Could be a small DDoS or bursty batch jobs.
Jin (runtime): stack traces point to blocking in the infer-worker queue. runtime.max_inflight currently 64 on rtd-02; queue backlog is growing and eviction isn't keeping up.
Priya (sre): let's avoid full redeploy. Plan: 1) throttle noisy routes 2) raise max_inflight temporarily 3) shed low-priority traffic 4) notify affected customers. Can we do rate-limits quickly?
Maya R.: I can push a quick per-route rate limit for /v1/generate on hosted tier to 50r/s via edge-config service. Command: `redwood-cli edge update-rate --route /v1/generate --limit 50`
Sam O'Neill: please do that. Also set a burst to 100 for short spikes.
Maya R.: done (edge-commit 5f3a). Applied global /v1/generate limit 50r/s, burst 100 for hosted. Monitoring now.
Jin (runtime): I'll increase runtime.max_inflight to 96 on the rtd-02 pool as a soft change (no restart) via runtime-config; this will allow more concurrent in-flight requests. Patch: `kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n infra --patch \"{\"data\":{\"max_inflight\":\"96\"}}\"`
deploy-bot: runtime-config patched in cluster rtd-02 (commit 89c7).
Priya (sre): note: increasing max_inflight risks OOMs if model memory growth per request is high. Jin can you confirm memory headroom?
Jin (runtime): checked — GPU memory headroom ~18% on most nodes, it's tight but should be safe for +32 concurrent. Keeping an eye.
Tomas L.: support: any customer-facing impact yet? SupportBot flagged a handful of elevated error reports but no support tickets opened.
Sam O'Neill: initial customer impact: some long-tail paid customers saw 500s for streaming requests; dedicated customers on reserved pools mostly unaffected. We'll prioritize reducing noise.
Maya R.: applying quick shedding rule: header X-Priority: low -> drop at ingress when queue > 80%. Edge rule deployed.
Sam O'Neill: good. Also enable dynamic timeout tuning: reduce downstream encoder timeout from 12s to 8s for public tier to free capacity quicker. Jin can you apply that on rtd-02?
Jin (runtime): applying encoder timeout 8s via `runtime-config:set encoder_timeout=8s` now.
deploy-bot: encoder_timeout change applied (rtd-02).
Priya (sre): I'm watching SLO and 5xx. After limits and shedding we should see backlog come down; if not we escalate to circuit-break route -> fallback lighter model.
Sam O'Neill: after the changes we're seeing queue depth drop from 98% -> 55% within 3m. 5xx rate down 60%. Nice work. :thumbsup:
Maya R.: follow-up: throttled clients list — two high-volume API keys: key-A (internal partner) and key-B (third-party integrator). Key-B responsible for ~40% of burst traffic. Recommend applying per-key quota for key-B: 25r/s.
Sam O'Neill: Maya, apply per-key quota and notify Tomas to send a heads up.
Maya R.: applied per-key rate limit for key-B = 25r/s (edge-config commit 5f3b). Notifying support.
Tomas L.: prepping a short note to affected customers: "We've applied temporary throttles to reduce service instability; we'll follow up with usage and suggested mitigations." Will post to status and ping partners.
SupportBot: Status page updated: Incident 1759876543 - Partial degradation for some streaming requests on hosted API.
Priya (sre): next mitigation if we see recurrence: enable model-variant fallback for /v1/generate to a smaller quantized model on heavy routes; that reduces latency and memory. Need product OK to change model mapping briefly.
Sam O'Neill: product ok with temporary fallback for <5% of traffic for the next 30m to stabilize. Jin coordinate.
Jin (runtime): rolling canary of fallback mapping to rtd-02 worker group started (canary 10%). Monitoring impact.
Sam O'Neill: can we also increase backend request timeout for dedicated customers back to 12s if they require it? We shouldn't degrade dedicated SLA.
Maya R.: dedicated pool exempted from global edge throttle and fallback mapping. Confirmed.
Priya (sre): summary for handoff: 1) edge throttle on /v1/generate 50r/s burst 100 2) per-key quota for key-B=25r/s 3) shedding of low-priority header (X-Priority: low) 4) max_inflight bumped to 96 on rtd-02 5) encoder timeout reduced to 8s public tier 6) fallback canary to quantized model 10% 7) support notified and status page updated.
Sam O'Neill: next on-call (tomorrow 03:00 UTC) please pick up any regressions; primary contacts: Jin (runtime) and Maya (edge). I'll leave a short runbook in the incident doc.
Tomas L.: sent outbound messages to partners for key-B and to partner success for key-A.
Priya (sre): Post-incident action items: - run load replay for key-B pattern and tune batching/caching suggestions - evaluate eviction policy on KV cache - add automated signal to temporarily disable streaming for non-paid plans - document threshold for max_inflight increase and safe memory headroom.
Sam O'Neill: agreed. Closing immediate paging loop as mitigations are holding. Marking thread resolved but keeping it open for handoff notes. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident 1759876543 status -> mitigated (auto-update).
Sam O'Neill: Handoff note: if backlog climbs above 75% again, revert encoder_timeout to 12s only for dedicated and trigger fallback mapping to 50% while we investigate.
Jin (runtime): I'll prepare a safe rollback script for max_inflight and encoder_timeout changes: `rb-rollback-1759876543.sh` and put it in /runbooks/incidents/.
Maya R.: will create a follow-up PR to make per-key quotas more visible in the quota dashboard.
Tomas L.: will draft a short customer postmortem blurb for impacted partners.
SupportBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up meeting in 2 hours for RCA and owner assignment.
Sam O'Neill: thanks everyone. Ending active thread, keeping the runbook link in the incident doc.
